updates.title: New Built-in Entra Role: SOC Identity Responder
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra introduced a new SOC Identity Responder role to enable security operations teams to perform identity containment actions from Microsoft Defender with least-privilege access, reducing the need for analysts to hold multiple high-privilege roles or depend on identity administrators during incident response.

updates.title: External Users Directly Assignable to Access Packages
updates.summary: Entitlement Management now allows admins to assign external users not yet in the directory directly to access packages using their email address, with users automatically invited as guests and subject to governance policies.

updates.title: Extended Conditional Access Protections for AI Agent User Accounts
updates.summary: Conditional Access now supports targeting and protecting AI agent user accounts with greater precision using Custom Security Attributes and agent risk policies, allowing admins to enforce controls specific to agent behavior.

updates.title: Domainless SAML IdP Federation for Workforce Tenants
updates.summary: External users can now authenticate using SAML federation without requiring domain matching between their email and preconfigured IdP domains, simplifying federated identity scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Now Generally Available
updates.summary: Entra Backup and Recovery, enabled by default, automatically backs up critical directory objects including users, groups, applications, Conditional Access policies, and authentication policies to enable recovery from accidental or malicious changes.

updates.title: SCIM 2.0 APIs for Microsoft Entra ID in US Gov Cloud
updates.summary: SCIM 2.0 APIs are now generally available in US Government cloud, providing a standards-based method for developers and partners to manage users and groups in Microsoft Entra.

updates.title: AD Group Enforcement to Prevent Unauthorized Changes
updates.summary: Cloud Sync now allows admins to designate specific Active Directory groups so modifications can only occur through Entra provisioning, blocking out-of-band changes and preventing group drift.

updates.title: Jailbreak/Root Detection in Microsoft Authenticator App
updates.summary: Microsoft Authenticator now blocks work or school accounts on rooted or jailbroken devices, enforcing compliance with device security posture and requiring users to move to compliant devices.

updates.title: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) Support for Windows with Entra Registration
updates.summary: Windows BYOD support using Entra registration is now generally available, allowing users to access corporate resources from their own devices with administrator-controlled access policies.

updates.title: Improved Kerberos Key Rotation Reliability for Entra ID
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Kerberos key rotation now validates decryption with both primary and secondary keys, improving reliability in environments using incoming trust referral flows and preventing authentication failures during rotation.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Integrated with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, preventing sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications and detecting risky activity through Insider Risk Management.

updates.title: Enriched Audit Data for Matched DLP Rules
updates.summary: DLP audit records in Exchange Online now capture enriched match details including sender domain, subject keywords, attachment type, and recipient information in addition to Sensitive Information Type matches, improving compliance monitoring and policy tuning.

updates.title: DLP Rule-based Alert Tagging and Auto-resolution
updates.summary: DLP now supports rule-based alert tagging and auto-resolution, allowing administrators to automatically resolve low-priority alerts and tag alerts for routing without manual triage.

updates.title: DLP SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP introduces an out-of-box MTTA/MTTD/MTTR SLA reporting dashboard allowing admins to define custom SLAs for alert severity levels and monitor operational performance against compliance metrics.

updates.title: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Sensitivity labels can now be applied directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups, extending data classification and governance controls with no additional label configuration needed.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now consolidates Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list page with unified management, agent summaries, and system-generated notes for status changes.

updates.title: Expanded User Profile Details in Insider Risk Management Alerts
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management alert experience now displays additional user profile signals from Microsoft Entra including office location, employee type, department, and last working date.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56191 Microsoft Exchange Online Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Online allows unauthorized attackers to perform tampering over a network; administrators should apply security patches immediately.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62825 Azure Key Vault Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication flaw in Azure Key Vault allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network; organizations managing encryption keys should prioritize patching.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62835 Online Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in Online Services allows unauthorized attackers to disclose information over a network; this may impact multiple Microsoft 365 workloads and requires urgent patching.
